findings.title: Forced Apple RAW9 plus Lumen's wide-gamut working space turns all three supplied Sony RAWs cyan
findings.trigger: Fresh RAW with no recipe decoder version, on tested macOS 27 arm64. Apple chooses decoder 8; supported versions are [7,8,9]; Lumen forces 9.
findings.effect: The decoded buffer already loses red, before Lumen WB/tone/color/denoise. A7401502 direct flat v8 mean RGB [0.133833,0.133078,0.122484], v9 [0.033745,0.150265,0.113542]. Pixels with any nonpositive channel rise 0.0685%→43.56%. A7401654 rises 2.73%→74.27%; A7401693 0.261%→79.86%. Lumen WB matrix at default is identity; disabling denoise does not repair the cast.
findings.blindSpot: The fallback verifies outputImage is non-nil, not that pixels retain color. Synthetic render goldens cannot test camera decoder selection. Must compare actual RAW against Apple's per-file default, with rendered pixels.
findings.workingSpaceIsolation: On A7401502, RAW9 is healthy in default/linear-sRGB working space: common Rec2020 readback mean RGB [0.133965,0.138112,0.124154], nonpositive fraction 0.3312%. Linear-P3 yields [0.097522,0.142875,0.117251], 5.2712%; linear-Rec2020 yields [0.033745,0.150265,0.113542], 43.5558%. RAW8 is nearly invariant across the same contexts. Visually verified both RAW9 default and Rec2020 PNGs. This isolates a RAW9/custom-wide-working-space integration failure, not a blanket defect in RAW9.
findings.history: New environment/file-based reproduction at main. Do not generalize to all cameras/macOS versions. Apple's related RAW9/custom-working-space DNG report is a different camera and not proof of an identical underlying bug.
findings.direction: Respect and pin Apple's per-file default for fresh images; retain explicit recorded decoder choices and add these real-camera comparisons. If opting into RAW9, isolate its decode to a validated working space before conversion to Lumen's Rec2020 pipeline, with actual rendered-pixel checks.
